commitMessage: jarvise: P3H safe batching and rate-limit circuit breaker (no network, no execution grant)

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: P3H safe batching: add HTTP 429 rate-limit circuit breaker on the existing acquirer without mutating the P3G execution grant, incident root, or network authorization. Preserve P3F acquisitionRoot binding and P3E factory-after-reservation order.
P3H offline fake-provider coverage for 429 circuit breaker, ordinal burn, batch N counting, resume advancement, pinned local allowance and provider concurrency <= 1. Zero Yahoo/network contact.
P3H safe batching: parse --max-new-provider-keys and --inter-key-delay-ms, fail-closed on unknown args, and stop after N new provider keys. No Yahoo fetch and no execution-grant mutation.
P3H offline CLI/runner coverage for --max-new-provider-keys, --inter-key-delay-ms, unknown-arg fail-closed, batch N, resume advancement and pacing. Zero Yahoo/network contact.
